title: Features
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM
The Check Benefit Free Period operation provides information about benefit-free periods. Benefit-free periods occur for an

insurance contract if open items with a due date in the past are dunned, for example, and dunning levels defined in Customizing
are reached within the corresponding dunning procedure.

You can Use the Check Benefit Free Period operation in claim processing to check whether the insurer has to settle the claim or
whether the insurer is benefit-free at the time where the claim happened due to missing payments from the customer.

Features

The selection is done by the Insurance Contract Reference ID element, which is the internal ID of the underlying insurance object
in Colletions/Disbursements. The operation returns the periods, in which the insurance contract was or is benefit-free.

Note:

The benefit-free periods are defined via dunning level categories. The dunning levels with dunning level categories 05 (benefit-
free), 08 (legal proceedings - with automatic clearing), or O9 (legal proceedings - without automatic clearing) are regarded as

benefit-free. The creation data of the dunning notice represents the start of the benefit-free period.

Error Handling

Error messages are returned in the error log.

Message Types

e InsuranceContractBenefitFreePeriodBylnsuranceContractIDAndClaimPeriodQuery

e InsuranceContractBenefitFreePeriodBylnsuranceContractIDAndClaimPeriodResponse

Prerequisites

You can only use the Check Benefit Free Period operation if the business function SAP for Insurance:
Collections/Disbursements 1 is active and if the dunning by dunning procedure for insurance companies is used.

Constraints

You can only use the Check Benefit Free Period if you use the dunning by dunning procedures for insurance companies.

Note that the start of the benefit-free period might be several days afterwards from a legal perspective, since it takes some days
until the dunning letter reaches the customer and there might also be buffer for him to react.

Notes on SAP Implementation

Configuration

You set the relevant dunning level categories in Customizing for Collections/Disbursements , under Business Transactions ->
Dunning -> Dunning by Dunning Procedure -> Configure Dunning Procedure . The dunning levels with dunning level categories
05 (benefit-free), 08 (legal proceedings - with automatic clearing) or 09 (legal proceedings - without automatic clearing) are
regarded as benefit-free.
